subject: Segmented retention / region binding questions from AcmeBank — roadmap ask
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmebank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: AcmeBank Legal <legal@acmebank.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Question: per-tenant retention windows + region binding for PII-sensitive projects

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team followed up with a few concrete requirements while we prep for procurement. High level: we need the ability to bind certain tenants (workspaces) to a specific geo (US-east, EU) for both storage residency and deletion semantics. A few bullet items they asked to confirm: 

- Can retention be set per-tenant and enforced server-side (not just UI labels)? We want retention to apply even if an engineer tries to move data or change flags.
- For tenants that are geo-bound to the US, can backups/replicas be restricted to US regions (no cross-border replication)?
- For deletion: does the platform support an irreversible purge versus a soft-delete with legal hold override? We need an auditable sequence for erasures.

I attached our short requirements doc. Can you point me to the right contact to discuss feasibility and an approximate timeline for delivery (we're targeting an onboarding in Q1).

Appreciate it,
Lena

---
Lena Ortiz
Head of Cloud Security Programs
AcmeBank
attachments: acmebank-retention-requirements-20261028.pdf (PDF, 150KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: lena.ortiz@acmebank.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question: per-tenant retention windows + region binding for PII-sensitive projects

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear doc and the call follow-up. Looping in Lauren (Product) and Rishi (Infra) so we can give concrete answers. Quick answers up front:

- Per-tenant retention enforced server-side: yes, the control plane supports a retention policy attached to a tenant id. Current implementation is primarily policy-enforced at the API layer and at purge time by the storage pipeline; we need to confirm that admin API-only changes can be restricted by RBAC (this is currently possible but we should document it).
- Cross-border replication for backups: today snapshots may be replicated for reliability to our multi-region object store depending on customer config; restricting replication to a single geo is an enterprise/private feature we can enable but it's not fully automated in the current hosted default.
- Deletion modes: we have soft-delete (30/90 day soft retention) + irreversible purge. Legal hold currently can prevent purge but is a manual operator workflow; we need to add an API-level legal-hold flag that prevents irreversible deletes and surfaces in audit logs.

Action items:
1) Rishi — confirm replication topology for Dedicated vs Hosted and feasibility of per-tenant no-replication mode.
2) Lauren — can Product scope an admin API + Console UI control for per-tenant region binding + legal hold flag (include RBAC model)?
3) I'll prepare a short feasibility note and estimated Q1 roadmap slot if Product agrees.

Would you be available for a 30-min call Tuesday (10/31) to run through tradeoffs?

Best,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Product Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-28T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question: per-tenant retention windows + region binding for PII-sensitive projects

Karthik / team —

Quick infra notes after spike with infra-oncall:
- Dedicated pools: we can pin a tenant's data to a single region by ensuring object storage and GPU serving nodes are provisioned in that region. That works today for Dedicated customers with a configuration step; we would need to automate that as a "tenant flag" for Hosted.
- Backups/snapshots: current automated snapshots may be copied cross-region for HA. We can add a per-tenant snapshot policy that disables cross-region copy; storage cost + SLO tradeoffs to document.
- Soft-delete vs irreversible purge: purge is orchestrated by the data-retention pipeline. We can add a legal-hold boolean in metadata that short-circuits purge flows; to be auditable it must be immutable except through a separate hold-release workflow (with approvals).

Estimated engineering work: 3 sprints (infra) + 2 sprints (platform API + console) to deliver a basic v1 that exposes: per-tenant region flag, per-tenant snapshot replication flag, and legal-hold API. Additional effort: RBAC and audit log surface (another 2 sprints).

Risks:
- Cold-path cross-region failover will be more complex if replication disabled.
- Required compliance proof for some banks may demand in-country KMS; that's a separate workstream.

I'll volunteer to scope infra tasks; need Product to prioritize.

Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Engineering Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-29T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question: per-tenant retention windows + region binding for PII-sensitive projects

Thanks — this is helpful. My suggested product approach:

1) v1 (Q1): Admin API + Console flag per-tenant: region_binding (enum: us, eu, global), snapshot_replication (boolean), retention_period_days (integer), legal_hold (boolean, with created_by + timestamp stored). UI shows warnings when replication disabled. RBAC: only Org Admins + Security Admin role can set region_binding and legal_hold.

2) v1 scope to prioritize: enforce server-side retention at purge time and surface retention metadata in audit logs. Postpone in-country KMS and fully air-gapped backup until v2.

3) Compliance artifacts: Soojin — can you assemble an initial SOC2/ISO note showing how the legal_hold/audit trail will be implemented so we can share with Acme? Lena asked explicitly for an "auditable sequence" for erasures.

Timeline ask: If infra can commit to the 3 sprints estimate, we can slot API + Console work in Q1. I'll draft a short MRD and a canary rollout plan (tenant opt-in, then force-on for select enterprise customers).

Attaching a quick mock of the admin UI (attached).

- Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Group Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com

Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question: per-tenant retention windows + region binding for PII-sensitive projects

Hi Lena — looping back with a short compliance note and next steps.

- "Auditable sequence" for erasures: when a tenant requests deletion the platform will record a deletion_request entry (id, tenant_id, requested_by, timestamp). If legal_hold == true, the request is flagged and blocked with an automated notification to security/legal. When legal_hold is cleared via an approvals workflow, the purge job will run and write an immutable purge_record (job_id, objects_removed_count, timestamp, operator_id). All events are retained in the audit log for 7 years (configurable for enterprise).
- Proof points we'll provide: sequence diagrams, sample audit log entries, and a sample DSAR+erasure report.

Next steps:
1) We propose a 30-min scoping call with your security and procurement teams on Tue 10/31 at 11:00 PT to walk through the v1 behavior and the tradeoffs.
2) We will share an MRD + draft SOC/ISO note prior to the call.

Thanks — we want to make sure the roll-out matches your compliance needs.

Regards,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Security & Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference
